description: Verifies a Kaneme certificate from its TOKEN (from a /certificat/… URL or a badge). Returns the PUBLIC attestation: issuer, type (text or voice), the authorship band or maturity level, subject, date, engine version and page URL. Never a fine-grained score: only what the public page shows. NO credits, no voice required, any token, including another account’s. Unknown, invalid or revoked token = `verified:false`: "not attested", NEVER an outage to retry. When an issuer key is provisioned, `trust` carries a detached Ed25519 signature (verifiable offline).
name: verify_certificate
title: Verify a public certificate
